$comment: Events taken by hand from an official organiser announcement or schedule.
This file exists because there is no free public API for Indian cricket or
most Indian live events, and scraping a ticketing site is both fragile and
against its terms. The honest alternative is a small curated list where
every entry carries the official page it was read from, so a reader can
check the claim rather than trusting us.
- sourceUrl MUST be an official organiser or governing-body page
(bcci.tv, iplt20.com, icc-cricket.com, a venue's own site). Never a
ticket reseller, never a news aggregator, never a scraper.
- verifiedAt is the date a human opened that page and confirmed the
fixture. Re-check before a demo; schedules move.
- Nothing here is ever invented. An entry with no source does not ship.
Seats, prices, payment and tickets remain simulated for these events, in
exactly the same way as for every other event in FairQueue.
